Rubric coverage: R2.7, R2.4, RB.5, RB.6

# Uncertainty, generated by `scripts/lca_uncertainty.py`

Monte Carlo: 20,000 draws, seed 20261021, 45 parameters varied independently (triangular low/central/high unless the YAML says uniform). Main basis: Ostrołęka PIS quantities; rows prefixed x_ are the bottom-up cross-check on the same draws. Cross-check draws where the scaled whole-plant concrete fell below the C1 target volume (whole plant set equal to target): 696 (3.5%).
